parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit fails. The module reaches persistence through gateway ports: LendingService injects BookGateway, MemberGateway and LoanGateway. LoanHistoryService does not use that abstraction. Its constructor injects PrismaService, an ORM client, and runs ORM queries against it (this.db.loanEvent.findMany). Its note() method also goes around its own injected client: it builds a new PrismaClient() from @prisma/client on every call and runs db.loanEvent.create directly. So within one file, persistence is reached two different ways, and neither way goes through a gateway or repository. The flags at lines 16 and 18 (direct ORM use, repository bypass) are confirmed. The flag at line 22 is confirmed only in part: it does query the ORM directly, but through the injected PrismaService rather than a raw PrismaClient. I found no rule or validation copied between the two files.

violations.message: note() calls new PrismaClient() from @prisma/client and runs loanEvent.create on it. This goes around both the injected PrismaService and the module's gateway abstraction.

LoanHistoryService injects PrismaService and queries the ORM directly (loanEvent.findMany). The rest of the module reaches persistence only through gateway ports (BookGateway, LoanGateway, MemberGateway), so this file breaks the module's consistent abstraction.
